title: A marked secret rule ran before PEM redaction in log text, so a key after password= kept its body
resolution: Log text now redacts PEM private keys before the marked secret rules; a logger test covers fields and correlation.

title: Revealed-value spans were replaced before the PEM scan, so a revealed word inside a key marker exposed the key body
resolution: PEM key spans are found in the original text and merged with the revealed spans before replacement; tests cover redactSecrets and redactFailure.

title: A missing installation CA let an initialized installation fall back to a plain broker connection
resolution: A missing CA is allowed only before the installation record exists; otherwise the settings and broker commands fail with the path before connecting, and re-issue still runs.

title: The tracked private key check missed indented YAML keys and JSON-escaped keys such as the authority document
resolution: The check also matches an indented line break and an escaped one; tests use keys generated at run time and keep bare markers in code allowed.

title: The issuer accepted an authority certificate with another authority's key, and re-issue could replace working files
resolution: The adapter refuses an authority that is no CA or does not match its key, and every certificate is issued before any file is written; a test shows the files stay unchanged.

title: The default broker CA was read with readFileSync, outside the namespace's link, owner, and mode checks
resolution: The CA is read through ControlPlaneNamespace; tests refuse a symbolic link, a file readable by others, and another owner.

title: The CertificateIssuer port had no shared conformance suite for its adapters
resolution: CERTIFICATE_ISSUER_CONFORMANCE in @taskelith/fleet takes the issuer and a certificate inspector; the x509 adapter runs it with the Node inspector of @taskelith/testing.

title: verify-installation stopped and started after the re-issue, hiding whether the command itself restarts the services
resolution: Right after the command, a probe compares the certificates the API and NATS present with the new files and a worker heartbeat must arrive; without the restart the check failed.

title: The guide implied that the browser certificate variables work in Compose, which passes and mounts neither
resolution: The guide, the contract, and the local installation delta state that the composition serves the API certificate until 26d and separate the direct start.

title: verification.md named the base before the merge of origin/dev
resolution: The record names the merge c12a7425 and its merge base 3f23516a, what it brought in, and the checks repeated after it.

title: The server certificate ended 397 days after issuance instead of 397 days after its backdated start
resolution: The end is computed from notBefore, and the test asserts the difference of the two ends.
